items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: I was with Buddy P.T. Not for no, played with him, you know, for sure.

ctx.x: Well, he could teach you all instruments. All instruments. Violin. He was more specialized in violin play. And string instrument, he specializes in that. First up, we haven't got very much now as string instrument teachers. Just to a certain extent, you have, but not playing by music, or learning to read the music, well that's pretty hard. The most of the players are just from the air, playing by air, you know? It's a very few of the old players around here I have played on different occasions. You take like…
Well now, who was in Buddy Patek's band when you were working with him?

Me and George Washington. And who else was with me and Buddy George Washington. Oh, and this Les Short-Jumma, I can't call his name. And I think Drags was playing Pace, if I'm not mistaken. And who the Clannette played, I can't recall his name now, he passed on.
